text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Kyaru and the others followed their homeroom teacher to the classroom. At last, the curtains opened on their life as transfer students
text_block_list.orig_text:
担任の案内で教室へとやってきたキャルたち。
ついに編入生としての学園生活が幕を開ける──

text_block_list.name: Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: C'mon, take a seat, don't make a fuss! I'll introduce you to the transfer student we're going to be learning with starting today!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほらー
席着け、
ざわざわすんなー！
今日から一緒に学ぶことになる編入生を紹介するぞ！

text_block_list.name: Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
The first one's already coming in!
Alright, {0}! Say hello!
text_block_list.orig_text:
一人目はもう入って来てくれてんな！
よし{0}！　
挨拶してくれ！

text_block_list.name: Female Student 1
text_block_list.text:
Nice to meet you!
Wow, you're pretty cool♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
よろしくー！
へぇ、
結構かっこいいかも♪

text_block_list.name: Male Student 1
text_block_list.text:
What, you're a guy?
Well, let's get along!
text_block_list.orig_text:
んだよ男かよー
ま、
仲良くしよーぜ！

text_block_list.name: Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Alright, next!
Come on in, Kyaru!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よーし、
じゃあ次だ！
キャル
入ってこーい！

text_block_list.name: キャル
text_block_list.text:
……よし
出番よ。
大丈夫、
完璧にこなしてみせるわ。
見せてやろうじゃない……
あたしの挨拶ってやつを！！
text_block_list.orig_text:
……よし
出番よ。
大丈夫、
完璧にこなしてみせるわ。
見せてやろうじゃない……
あたしの挨拶ってやつを！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...Ahem.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
コホン。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Nice to meet you~ I'm Kyaru☆... This might be my first time in a place like this, so I might cause you trouble, but I'll do my best to get used to it quickly♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
はじめまして～
あたしはキャルです☆
……
こういうトコは初めてで
迷惑かけちゃうかもですけど、
早くなじめるように
頑張りますねっ♪

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on you! ☆
text_block_list.orig_text: よろしくおねがいしま～す☆

text_block_list.name: キャル
text_block_list.text:
……決まったわ。
セイシュンといえばまずは友達づくり。
自分でも気持ち悪いくらい猫被ってたけど
第一印象が良ければこっちのもんよ……！
text_block_list.orig_text:
……決まったわ。
セイシュンといえばまずは友達づくり。
自分でも気持ち悪いくらい猫被ってたけど
第一印象が良ければこっちのもんよ……！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Who are you saying is imitating Ahorine?!
I'm gonna kill you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だ、
誰がアホリーヌの真似してるってのよ！！
ぶっ殺すぞ！？

text_block_list.name: Female Student 1
text_block_list.text: Kill...?
text_block_list.orig_text: ぶっ殺……？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
No! Th-That was...!
That was just a joke...!
You made me lose my cool in an instant....
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっ！　ち、
違うの！　
今のは弾みで……！
ちょ、
あんたのせいで一瞬で化けの皮が……

text_block_list.name: Male Student 2
text_block_list.text:
Wha?!
C-Cute...!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なっっっ！？
か、
かわいい……っ！！

text_block_list.name: Female Student 2
text_block_list.text: Huh? Could it be that the other transfer student is Suzuna, the model?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
まって！？
もしかして、
もう一人の編入生って
モデルのスズナちゃん！！？

text_block_list.name: Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Oooh, that's a celebrity for you. Everyone knows? Then last but not least, Suzuna! Introduce yourself, please.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おお、
さすが有名人。
みんな知ってるのか。
じゃあ
最後スズナ！　
自己紹介頼むぞ。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Sups! It's Suzuna~♪
Let's all get along! Yahallo♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょす～！　
スズナだよ～♪
みんな仲良くしてね！　
ヨロ～♪

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Ooooooohhhh!!!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: うおおおおおおおお！！！！！

text_block_list.name: Male Student 1
text_block_list.text:
F-For seat!
There's an open seat next to me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
せ、
席！　
俺の隣空いてるぜ！

text_block_list.name: Female Student 2
text_block_list.text:
I-It's empty next to me, too!
I've been Suzuna's fan for a long time!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
私の隣も空いてるわ！
ずっと前からスズナちゃんのファンなの！！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Kyahaha! Thanks~♪
But I've already decided who's sitting next to me!
Right, Hidesai?
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃはは！　
ありがと～♪
でも～
うち
隣に座る人
もう決めてるんだ！
ね、
ヒデサイ♪

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaat~~?!
text_block_list.orig_text: えええええ～～～！！？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...They took it all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……全部
持ってかれた。

text_block_list.name: Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong, Kyaru? You look pale.
Want to go to the nurse's office?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしたキャル、
顔色悪いぞ？
保健室行くか？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm fine!
Just calm down and start class already!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だ、
大丈夫よ！
いいから騒いでんの落ち着かせて、
さっさと授業始めてよね！

text_block_list.name: Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: All right, first period is "Fundamentals of Magic ①". I'm going to hand out the igniters we'll be using today... Oh, and for the transfer group, turn your textbooks to the first page.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よーし、
一時間目は『魔法基礎Ⅰ』だ。
じゃあ、
今日使う着火剤配ってくぞー
っと、
編入組は
隣に教科書見せてもらってくれな。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...Um, can you share the textbook?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あの、
教科書
いい？

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Student
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Go ahead and look.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ？　
……勝手に見ろや。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
What's with that attitude? I'll ki--
......Oh, thank you. I'll take a look, then.
text_block_list.orig_text:
何よその態度ぶっ殺……
あ、
ありがとう。
じゃあ見せてもらうわね。

text_block_list.name: Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Alright, you've passed the igniter
You need use your magic to light that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし、
着火剤は渡ったなー
みんなには
魔法を使って
これに火をつけてもらう！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Whaaat? The difficulty level is suddenly so high? Can Hidesai do it~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えー
いきなり難易度鬼じゃね？
ヒデサイできる～？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Mmmmmmmm... I can't do it.
Ah! Kyaru-chi can do it! As expected~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
むむむむむ～～～……
んー、
できないね。
あっ！　
キャルっちできてる！　
さっすが～♪

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: No, this is too easy. I can see why you guys would have a hard time with this, since you don't have any experience with magic.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや簡単すぎよこんなの。
ま、
魔法に縁のないあんたたちが苦労するのは分かるけど。

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Student
text_block_list.text:
Bah! ...Who need magic to do something like this......!
You can just light a fire with a match!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ケッ！　
……んなムズイ魔法使えっかよ！
火なんてマッチでつけりゃいいだろーが！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? You’re a student at the Academy of Magic, aren’t you? This is on the level of an elementary schooler. If we talk about arithmetic, it's the first step of 99.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……は？　
仮にも魔法学園の生徒なんでしょ？
こんなの小学生レベルね。
算数でいえば九九の一の段よ。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Wait, why is everyone else holding their heads in their hands...? Don't tell me they can't even do simple magic like this...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
って
ちょっと、
他のみんなも頭抱えちゃってない……？
まさか
こんな簡単な魔法もできないとか……？

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Student
text_block_list.text: It's Obviously. This class is a nest of loser magic dropouts.....and it's also known as the "loser" class.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ったりめーだろ？
このクラスはア魔学の落ちこぼれの巣窟……
通称・ダメ組だぜ？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! What's that supposed to mean?!
Wait, why am I in the loser class?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はあ！？　
なによそれ！？
ってか
なんであたしがダメ組に入れられてんの！？

text_block_list.name: Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Ahh... Sorry about that, Kyaru. I'm sure you'll be able to keep up with the advanced classes, but... We had to adjust the number of students, and our class was the only one with seats.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー……
そこんとこは
すまねーな、
キャル。
お前なら特進クラスでもついていけるだろうが……
人数調整でどうしても
うちのクラスしか席がなくてよ。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
What the hell is that supposed to mean?!
that is so inappropriate...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
何よそれ、
超適当じゃない……！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Right♪ The special class is probably divided into people who are smart, right? If you go to a class like that, you'll be separated from us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だね♪　
特進クラスって
多分けっこー頭いい系っしょ？
そんなクラスいかれたら、
うちらと離れ離れになっちゃうし！

text_block_list.name: キャル
text_block_list.text:
……確かにそれはそうね。
よし、
じゃあやってやろうじゃない！
text_block_list.orig_text:
……確かにそれはそうね。
よし、
じゃあやってやろうじゃない！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Huh? Kyaru-chi, why wear glasses?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ
キャルっち、
なんでメガネ？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Hehe, everyone, look at me! I'll set an example for you! Here!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
みんな
こっちを見なさい！
あたしがお手本を見せてあげるわ！
それっ！！

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Student
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...!??
The igniter is igniting on its own!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うお……！？？
着火剤が勝手に！！

text_block_list.name: Female Student 1
text_block_list.text:
Mine too... Wait,
The igniters for the whole class are floating in the air....!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
私のも……
っていうか、
クラス全員の着火剤が宙に浮いて……！？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Woah, is this Kyaru-chi's magical trick?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヤバ、
これってキャルっちの魔法的な！？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
It’s not a trick, it’s magic!
Hmmm, This isn't much yet!
Look it!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
的
じゃなくて魔法よ！
ふふ、
こんなもんじゃないわよ！
それ！！

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Wahhh...!?
text_block_list.orig_text: わああ……！？

text_block_list.name: Male Student 1
text_block_list.text:
What the hell?
They all ignited at once?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだこれ、
一斉に発火しやがった！？

text_block_list.name: Female Student 2
text_block_list.text:
What's going on?
How are you doing this?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なになに、
どうやってんの？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, now then for the finale!
That's it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
じゃあ最後のダメ押し！
それー！

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Ooooooooh!!
text_block_list.orig_text: おおおおお～～～～！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ....Phew, it's basically like this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふう、
ざっとこんなもんよ。

text_block_list.name: キャル
text_block_list.text:
さあ、
あたしの実力に
驚愕するがいいわ！
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあ、
あたしの実力に
驚愕するがいいわ！

text_block_list.name: Female Student 1
text_block_list.text: Kyaru-chan!!
text_block_list.orig_text: キャルちゃん……！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Heehee. What is it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふん、
なにかしら？

text_block_list.name: Female Student 1
text_block_list.text:
You lost my igniter.
I was going to do it now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私の着火剤なくなっちゃったじゃん。
今やろうと思ってたのに。

text_block_list.name: Female Student 2
text_block_list.text:
*cough*! there's smoke everywhere...!
Open the window!
text_block_list.orig_text:
コホッ！　
もう、
煙いじゃない……！
窓開けて～！

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Student
text_block_list.text:
Tch!
Don't go showing off magic tricks with that smug face, shitty four-eyes!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ケッ！
どや顔で手品披露してんじゃねーよ
クソメガネ！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Shitty fo...?!!
text_block_list.orig_text: クソメ……！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
ふんっ！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Hey, Kyaru-chi, where are you going?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょ、
キャルっち
どこ行くのー！？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
I stumbled all over the place on the first day....
It wasn't supposed to be like this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
初日で思いっきりつまずいちゃったわ……
こんなはずじゃなかったのに……

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I wonder what's going on?
I can more or less imagine.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
どうしたのかしら？
って
大体想像できるけど。

text_block_list.text:
I guess you are put on the wrong class?
Isn't it Kyaru-san.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ダメ組の洗礼を浴びたってところかしら？
ねえ
キャルさん。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...Who are you?
text_block_list.orig_text: ……あんたは？

text_block_list.name: Student council president.
text_block_list.text: I'm the chairman of a special class. You must've been surprised by how low-level those loser class is. But don't get the wrong idea, that class in the school that is failing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私は特進クラスで委員長をしてるの。
驚いたでしょう？　
ダメ組のレベルの低さに。
でも
ア魔学でヤバいのはあのクラスだけだから誤解しないでね。

text_block_list.name: Student council president.
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, Kyaru-san, if that class isn't a fit for you.
Would you like to come to my special class?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
キャルさん、
あのクラスはあなたに相応しくないわ。
ぜひ我が特進クラスへ来てくださらない？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
It's a nice invitation, but it seems impossible.
Only the loser class has seats.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うれしいお誘いだけど、
無理みたいよ。
ダメ組しか席がないみたい。

text_block_list.name: Student council president.
text_block_list.text: I don't care about that. All I have to do is drop the most incompetent member of my class into the loser one♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなのどうとでもなるわよ。
うちのクラスで一番の無能を
ダメ組に落とせばいいだけだから♪

text_block_list.name: Student council president.
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Isn't that good idea, Kyaru-san?
I'll go ask the principal right away♪
If I say so, it'll be one shot...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ね、
それがいいわキャルさん。
さっそく私が学園長に頼んでくるわね♪
私が言えば一発で……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*...
I am fine, I'll stay in the loser class.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はあ……
いいわ、
ダメ組のままで。

text_block_list.name: Student council president.
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
なんで？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: I don't even know if there's anyone I can get along with, and the feeling of being thrown into a classroom at random is one of the trope of school life, isn't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
気の合うやつがいるかどうかも分かんなくて、
ランダムに教室放り込まれて不自由感じんのも、
学園生活の醍醐味ってもんでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Watch me now, I'm going to make those guys.....
definitely flip out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今に見てなさいよあいつら……
絶対に手のひら返させてやるわ！

text_block_list.name: Student council president.
text_block_list.text: Wait a minute! You don't belong in that cesspool with those incompetents! You'll end up as a.... Incompetent, too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
待ちなさいよ！　
あんな掃き溜めで無能どもといることないわ！
朱に交わればなんとやら……
あなたも無能になってしまうわよ！？

text_block_list.name: Student council president.
text_block_list.text: It's a good fit for the flamboyant looking incompetent woman who came with you and the lazy, burnt out, incompetent man who came with you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたと一緒にやってきた、
派手な見た目の無能女と、
のんびりにやけ面の無能男には
お似合いだけどね！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...Incompetent?
text_block_list.orig_text: ……無能？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Incompetent? You've been saying incompetent for a while now, Is that supposed to be a self-introduction?
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっきから無能無能って、
それって
自己紹介のつもり？

text_block_list.name: Student council president.
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? What do you mean, Kyaru?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……は？
どういうことかしら、
キャルさん？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: By incompetent, you mean those who can't achieve their goal. So, your goal is to get me into a special advanced class, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
無能ってさ、
目標を達成できないやつのことよね。
で、
あんたの目標は、
あたしを特進クラスに入れることでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Do you think you can achieve that goal by saying it now?
text_block_list.orig_text:
今の言い方で
その目標が達成できると思う？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ......Friends. I don't want to be in a class with someone who makes fun of my friends. I'm asking if you think I'll get in?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……友達を。
あたしの友達をバカにしたやつがいるクラスなんかに。
あたしが入ると思うかって聞いてんのよ？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Try saying something about Suzuna and that guy again. You'd better be prepared for that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう一度スズナとあいつのことを何か言ってごらんなさい。
その時は覚悟しておくことね。

text_block_list.name: Student council president.
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Getting carried away...!!
I'll never invite you again!
text_block_list.orig_text:
チッ……
調子に乗って……！！
もう二度と誘わないわ！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
That's for the best.
beeeeee!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは最高ね。
ん
べーーー
だ！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Kyaru-chi~♪♪♪

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
...!!
Hey, Suzuna, why are you here...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……！！
ちょ、
スズナ
なんでここに……！？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: What the matter? Aren't we friends, right?! I'm so happy~♪ I love you too, Kyaru-chi! I like you! I really love you!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだよ～
ちゃんと、
ともだちだって思ってくれてんじゃ～ん！
なんかすっごいうれしいよ～～♪
うちもキャルっち好き！　
好き！　
大好き！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Like I said, don't hug me...!!
Ugh... I can't breathe...
text_block_list.orig_text:
だーから抱きつくなって……！！
う……
息が苦し……

text_block_list.name: Male Student 1
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I thought she was a bad girl,
but Kyaru's a pretty nice girl, isn't she?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
いけすかねー奴かと思ってたけど、
キャルちゃん結構いい奴じゃん。

text_block_list.name: Female Student 1
text_block_list.text: Kyaru-chan, I said something a little nasty earlier. I'm sorry...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
キャルちゃん、
さっきはちょっといやな言い方しちゃった。
ごめんね……！

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Student
text_block_list.text: ...Keh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ……ケッ！

text_block_list.name: Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I chased after you because I was worried, but it looks like you're okay.
Everyone, let's go back to the classroom!
text_block_list.orig_text:
へへ、
心配で追いかけてきたが
大丈夫みたいだな。
みんな
教室へ戻るぞー！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Kyaru is accepted into the class despite her clumsiness. But school life has only just begun.
text_block_list.orig_text:
不器用ながらもクラスに受け入れられたキャル。
しかし学園生活はまだ始まったばかりである。
